text: The due-diligence file from June 2025 stating no loss was detected on the property is no longer valid. New evidence from 2026 indicates a tree-cover loss candidate of 13.5 hectares within the asset in 2025. This change is pending corroboration, meaning it needs to be confirmed by a later year's data and agreed upon by the JRC 2020 reference map. Therefore, the initial assessment of no loss is now outdated.
